title: The work-life balance myth for high performers
description: Test how a high-performance role defines workload, recovery, and availability before deciding whether its trade-offs fit your life.

The high performer at 11:47 p.m.

A reliable employee closes a laptop after another late call and tells friends the schedule is temporary. Recognition arrives, but so does a quieter fear: if the work stops, will the value disappear? A definition that survives the slogan
